about.en: CQUniversity, established in 1967, is one of Australia's premier recognized universities, holding a prominent global position (Rank 495 QS World University Rankings 2025 (5-Stars for Employability)). The university delivers world-class academic education and cutting-edge research in close collaboration with leading global industries, offering international students a dynamic multicultural campus and exceptional graduate career prospects.
